MEET YOUR DIETITIAN

Clinical nutrition care rooted in community.

Evidence-based care delivered with compassion, clarity and a personal approach.

Neo Boikanyo is a Clinical Dietitian providing outpatient and inpatient nutrition care in Randfontein and the surrounding communities. Her practice is based at Mkhwana Medical Centre in Mohlakeng, the community where she was born and raised, allowing her to give back to the area that shaped her journey. She combines evidence-based nutrition therapy with practical, patient-centred support to help individuals achieve better health outcomes.

With clinical experience dating back to 2009, Neo is passionate about medical nutrition therapy and its role in the prevention and management of a wide range of health conditions. In addition to her private practice, she provides inpatient nutrition care at Life Robinson Hospital and consults outpatients at the Life Robinson Dialysis Unit, National Renal Care at Lenmed Randfontein, and the West Rand Dialysis Unit.

Through her work, Neo is committed to strengthening nutrition care within the community and empowering individuals and families with clear, compassionate and personalised nutritional guidance.
